content.bridge_context: Deepening understanding of Decimal numbers and their place values.

units.title: Place Value beyond Units
units.explanation: Tenths (1/10), Hundredths (1/100), and Thousandths (1/1000) are to the right of the decimal point.
units.dual_language_instruction: Write 2.345 in expanded form. / 2.345 को विस्तारित रूप में लिखें।

units.title: Decimals and Fractions
units.explanation: Decimals can be converted to fractions by using the place value as the denominator.
units.dual_language_instruction: Convert 0.75 to a fraction. / 0.75 को भिन्न में बदलें।
